goal_level_decision_audit.decision: Run RayJoin as a focused Step-2 productized-runner A/B before any all-app Phoenix V3 run.
goal_level_decision_audit.different_path_now: Use this same-contract RayJoin packet to decide whether the point-location topology-stream family should advance, be redesigned, or be marked structural-only like RTDBSCAN.
goal_level_decision_audit.foolish_actions: The foolish move would be to compare runner vs Embree or toy data, then call it a V3 win.
goal_level_decision_audit.other_path: A broader all-app run is possible, but it would burn pod time before a second trunk family has shown material runtime-sourced gain.
goal_level_decision_audit.was_i_foolish: No. This follows the redesign dependency order and avoids another blended all-app run.
